title: VPC onprem install quick log
content:
Daily scratchpad: on-prem / VPC install notes (personal)

2026-03-10 09:20 — kickoff with AcmeCorp infra team
- customer environment: air-gapped rack in us-west customer colo; k8s 1.26 (kubeadm); internal CA; no outbound internet from worker nodes.
- objective: get basic Redwood Private control plane running in VPC overlay (IPsec) + agent on isolated cluster for evaluation.

High-level checklist (working):
- [x] Confirmed target kube-context and kubeconfig from customer (jumpbox access via bastion)
- [x] Received root CA bundle (acme-root.pem) and trust instructions
- [ ] Obtain service account token rotation policy from security (blocked) — asked Risk (Sara) 2026-03-11
- [ ] Create IAM-like mapping for Kubernetes RBAC -> RBAC shim (customer uses LDAP)
- [ ] Verify HSM/KMS integration path (customer uses Thales Luna)

Initial install steps tried (notes, errors):
1) bootstrap on jumpbox: scp private-installer.tar.gz -> jumpbox; untar; run ./install.sh --mode=airgap --kube-config=/home/ubuntu/kubeconfig
   - observed: installer attempted to fetch images from registry.redwood.ai and failed (expected). We need to point to mirrored images.
   - temporary fix: loaded images onto registry.local.acme:5000 and edited installer config values.yaml -> image.repository: registry.local.acme:5000/redwood
2) helm upgrade --install redwood-control ./charts/control -f values-local.yaml --namespace redwood-system
   - observed: pods crashloop with error "tls: certificate signed by unknown authority" in controller
   - root cause: our pods not trusting customer root CA. Need to inject CA into control plane truststore or mount /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt from host.
3) attempted workaround: mount acme-root.pem to /etc/ssl/certs/custom-ca.pem and update update-ca-certificates inside container image; didn't persist (init container failing prestart).

Blockers / to resolve ASAP:
- Customer requires mutual-TLS to the private control plane (mTLS at ingress). We need cert signed by their internal CA. Action: generate CSR from control-plane, hand off to Acme PKI for signing. Ticket RDW-4821 opened for CSR automation.
- HSM integration: installer expects AWS KMS, but customer has Thales. Need design for HSM plugin or accept local key material with escrow. Reach out to Diego for previous Thales notes.
- No outbound egress: our metrics agent needs to deliver telemetry to Console (unless routed through control plane). Plan: bundle metrics as push to control-plane collector over internal mesh; or customer to provide egress proxy. Ask infra: can we use bastion to relay?

Quick commands / snippets I used (save for later):
- load images to local registry: for img in $(cat images.txt); do docker pull $img && docker tag $img registry.local.acme:5000/$(basename $img) && docker push registry.local.acme:5000/$(basename $img); done
- helm install local: helm upgrade --install redwood-control ./charts/control -f values-local.yaml --namespace redwood-system --debug --wait --timeout 10m
- fetch logs: kubectl -n redwood-system logs deploy/redwood-controller -c controller --since=2h | sed -n '1,200p'

Notes on networking and firewall rules (customer provided):
- Allowed CIDR for control plane: 10.10.0.0/24 (control plane nodes)
- Pods assigned: 10.20.0.0/16 via calico (customer uses calico with IPIP off)
- Required firewall ports: 8443 (control plane API), 9090 (metrics collector), 50051 (agent gRPC). All must be opened within VPC overlay only.
- Bastion public IP: 52.10.34.12 — SSH jumpbox only.

Security reminders (do not forget):
- Do not upload private keys to Github or shared links. Use customer's vault for signed certs.
- Request KMS integration plan from security; record performance implications of HSM-based sign operations (latency).

Confluence and PR links to follow up:
- Confluence: private-deploy-guide-v2 (step where we document CSR flow for mTLS)
- PR: private-installer/#67 (tweaks for airgap image repo config)

Questions to ask customer on next call:
- Can we host a temporary image mirror in their environment (recommended) or do they prefer us to provide tarball of images via SFTP?
- Who will sign the CSR for mTLS? team/person + SLA for signing (need within 24–48h for testing)
- Confirm whether they allow a control-plane egress to telemetry.collect.redwood.ai over TLS (if yes, saves a lot of work; if no, we need local collector and retention window discussion)

Quick timeline estimate for next milestones:
- CSR automation + manual sign path: 1–2 days (if PKI contact responds)
- HSM adapter research & POC: 1 week (parallel)
- Airgapped image mirror and helm config validation: 2 days once mirror available

Next steps (today):
- 10:00 sync with Diego: hand off Thales notes + check HSM adapter baseline
- 11:30 open RDW-4821 with CSR automation checklist (I already created draft, need to add owner)
- Ping Acme PKI (acme-pki@acme.com) from customer SRE via shared channel to request cert sign (Sara to coordinate)
- Update values-local.yaml template to accept imageRegistry override via env var (quick patch)

Random personal reminders (notes-to-self):
- Keep a copy of acme-root.pem in local safe folder ~/.redwood/certs/acme-root.pem (chmod 600)
- When creating tickets, include exact pod logs and timestamps (makes it faster to diagnose)

End of scratchpad for now. Will update after Diego sync and PKI response.

Timestamp of last edit: 2026-03-13 08:45 (local)
